approval.scope: Adopt segmented quadrature for further model-only validation under a separately versioned amendment.
limitations: This approval does not authorize an observational fit.
Observed velocities must not be parsed for these validation gates.
No candidate verdict or physical confirmation follows from numerical validation.

changes: V3 uses axisymmetric_segmented_v1 instead of the frozen-v1 radial rational map.
V3b compares the CPU and GPU implementations of axisymmetric_segmented_v1.
unchanged: The 3-D source model, data, input hashes, censoring envelopes, sample, and radius selection.
The parameter grid and V3/V3b error definitions and thresholds.
V1, V2, V4, V5, all inferential choices, and all interpretation limits in the parent protocol.
The full frozen-v1 protocol remains intact and its original V3 result remains recorded.
amendment_scope.application: This amendment governs further model-only validation only. It does not retroactively alter earlier artifacts.

V3.radial_rule: Apply an order-n Gauss-Legendre rule independently on each finite source interval. Split at zero, every aligned profile-ring centre, each field radius inside the source support, and the frozen outer cutoff.
V3.vertical_rule: Retain the parent protocol's rational half-line map with order-n Gauss-Legendre nodes.

case_grid.radii: All positive-radius rows inside aligned density coverage; this is a conservative superset of the unevaluated velocity-dependent fit selection.

V3.error_metric: Maximum over retained radii of |V64^2 - V128^2| / max(|V128^2|, 0.01 km^2 s^-2), for every galaxy, envelope, alpha, and rho0 case.

V3b.comparison: Compare the CPU reference with the GPU implementation in float64 at both quadrature orders on every primary-source V3 case.
V3b.error_metric: Maximum over retained radii of |V_GPU^2 - V_CPU^2| / max(|V_CPU^2|, 0.01 km^2 s^-2).
V3b.sensitivity_variants: Not included in this amendment's V3b case grid.

retained_gates.V1: Unchanged: all required component-projection and reconstruction sensitivity variants must meet relative error < 1e-3.
retained_gates.V2: Unchanged: no second helium factor on measured gas profiles; synthetic global-mass envelopes include their explicit helium factor.
retained_gates.V4: Unchanged: Newtonian descriptive comparison using model components only; report when prerequisites permit.
retained_gates.V5: Unchanged: report model-only sensitivity effects across the frozen variants before any fit.
